acceptance_numbering.coordinator_clarification: The 11 stored acceptance items form seven criteria.

scope.owned: Agora paper/shadow presentation, parity copy, focused tests, and task evidence. A shared paperBookDisplay.tsx keeps the two paper surfaces consistent.
scope.unchanged: BFF fields, requests, adapter types, first-use ensure action/testid, and all existing data attributes.

criteria.1_copy: PASS: the three existing copy keys now explain Pantheon simulated paper fills, not actual fills, and no order buttons. Both locales have identical paper/shadow leaf keys and no snake-case code values. The timeout copy is also plain language.
criteria.2_paper_rows: PASS LOCALLY: shared labels cover symbol, localized side, share quantity, prices, currency, UTC time, and unrealized P&L. Missing values use a dash; absent currency is explicit rather than inferred. The fallback allowlists fields instead of serializing unknown input. Position/fill IDs and sources remain in data only. Existing selectors and ensure behavior are tested.
criteria.3_shadow: PASS LOCALLY: source kind is localized without its raw source. Known outcome fields have labels and units. Return/cost/drawdown/weight/exposure/confidence ratios are multiplied by 100; realized/unrealized amounts are not. Legacy pnl follows the existing comparison surface return-ratio convention. Unknown, identifier, provenance or unsupported fields are omitted and counted. Detail keys/actions and unavailable/degraded messages also avoid raw codes/JSON.
criteria.4_contract_proof: PASS: no BFF or adapter files changed. Read-only/no-order and simulated/not-actual-fill proof remains visible in plain words; machine data attributes remain intact.
criteria.5_verification: PASS: all existing tests retained; raw-code/JSON assertions replaced with plain-word plus absence checks. 153 cases passed, TypeScript passed, lint 0 errors, build passed.
criteria.6_hosted: PENDING POST-DEPLOY. Candidate Chromium screenshots show both paper sections free of the specified codes/JSON. The real BFF returns 404 for admintest, so populated-row browser proof is unavailable and the overall browser command exits 1. Decision-event reads return zero items; no real shadow comparison exists for this principal. Do not treat candidate assets or missing rows as deployed acceptance.
criteria.7_review: PENDING: assigned reviewer Claude2 is a different model family from owner Codex2. No independent approval is claimed.

selector_validation.method: Compared every existing data-* JSX attribute in the three touched components against origin/dev; none removed or changed. Confirmed no src/lib/bff files changed.

candidate_browser_proof.method: Authenticated Chromium as admintest at the maintained dev FE origin. Only candidate navigation/assets replaced; runtime config and all BFF responses remain hosted. Product mutations blocked; no fixture responses and no product writes.
